power_note: Eight distinct cells (B0 and B1 are duplicates by construction). At n=8 a two-sided Spearman test has roughly 25 percent power to detect rho=0.7 at the 5 percent level, so a null result here is uninformative and a significant one would rest on eight points, four of which share an instrument. This is reported as a descriptive association, not a test.
